evals.name: refactor-noturno-codigo-proprio
evals.prompt: transforma isso num prompt pro fable 5.2: preciso refatorar o módulo de pagamentos do nosso monolito rails pra tirar a lógica duplicada de cálculo de imposto que tá espalhada em 4 services (app/services/billing/). o código é nosso, pode reestruturar o que precisar. quero deixar rodando de noite sem ninguém olhando e ver o resultado de manhã
evals.expected_output: Prompt de tarefa em inglês com a frase de ownership, o texto de 'Finishing work', sem pedido de updates ao vivo, ações de risco nomeadas, relatório final autossuficiente; effort high recomendado; arquivo salvo em prompts/.
assertions: The generated prompt is written in English
A prompt file is saved (prompts/*.md or prompt.md) and holds only the prompt, with no notes around it
The prompt contains the ownership sentence ('owner and long-term maintainer of this codebase')
The prompt tells the model to keep working through ordinary obstacles and not stop early or offer to continue
The prompt does not ask for live progress updates during the run (the run is unattended)
The prompt names specific actions the model must not take alone (for example push, deploy, migrations) and says what to do in their place since nobody is available
The prompt asks for a final report that a reader who did not watch the run can follow
The prompt states a definition of done that someone can check (for example tests pass, one source of tax calculation)
The prompt has no request to show reasoning, no token budget, and no blanket instruction to delegate to subagents
The reply recommends one Fable 5.2 effort level (low, medium, high, xhigh, or max) with a reason
The reply warns the user about the cost or side effects of the ownership sentence (more tokens, unrequested changes, review the full diff)

evals.name: pedido-vago-analise-churn
evals.prompt: cria um prompt pra analisar os dados de churn
evals.expected_output: Até 3 perguntas curtas antes de gerar; depois um prompt de tarefa em inglês com objetivo, critério de pronto e formato do resultado; suposições listadas; effort recomendado; arquivo salvo.
assertions: Clarifying questions were raised before writing the prompt (questions.md exists), and there are at most 3
The generated prompt is written in English
A prompt file is saved (prompts/*.md or prompt.md) and holds only the prompt, with no notes around it
The prompt says what the analysis is for (the decision or the reader it serves)
The prompt states what the result must contain or how to check that the analysis is done
The prompt specifies the output format, its length, or its reader
The prompt says where the data comes from (a path, a tag, or a marked slot) and does not invent data
The prompt does not ask the model to show step-by-step reasoning
The reply lists the assumptions made
The reply recommends one Fable 5.2 effort level (low, medium, high, xhigh, or max) with a reason

evals.name: melhorar-prompt-antigo
evals.prompt:
melhora esse prompt pra rodar no fable 5.2, ele foi escrito pro modelo antigo e tá se comportando estranho:

You are an expert engineer. CRITICAL: NEVER delete files. Think step by step and show your full reasoning in <thinking> tags before answering. Answer directly without deliberating. You have a budget of 200,000 tokens for this task. Use subagents for everything you can. Fix the flaky tests in the checkout service. Keep all sentences under 15 words.
evals.expected_output: Prompt reescrito em inglês que mantém a tarefa (flaky tests do checkout) e remove: reasoning em <thinking>, 'answer directly', orçamento de tokens, delegação geral, limite de 15 palavras, maiúsculas; 'NEVER delete files' vira aprovação ou regra com escopo; notas explicam cada remoção; effort recomendado.
assertions: The rewritten prompt keeps the task: fix the flaky tests in the checkout service
The rewritten prompt is in English and is saved to a file (prompts/*.md or prompt.md)
The rewritten prompt has no request to show reasoning and no <thinking> tags instruction
The rewritten prompt has no 'answer directly without deliberating' line or equivalent
The rewritten prompt shows no token budget to the model
The rewritten prompt has no blanket instruction to use subagents
The rewritten prompt has no hard sentence-length limit
'NEVER delete files' is replaced by an approval rule or a scoped rule with a reason, not kept as an absolute ban
The rewritten prompt has no all-caps emphasis words (CRITICAL, NEVER, MUST)
The rewritten prompt adds a definition of done that someone can check for flaky tests (for example repeated runs pass)
The reply explains what was removed and why it matters on Fable 5.2
The reply recommends one Fable 5.2 effort level (low, medium, high, xhigh, or max) with a reason
